metadata.description: Curated demo subset of art_IVZc3TWCeE9f (Qwen3-8B, thinking off, T=1.0): 100 T1 grid-path programs (45 forced, 55 natural under baseline / single / multi-name bans) with mechanism labels, labeller details, full responses and PCA-50 activation coordinates, plus the small result files the analysis stages read and the full-run reference numbers.

selection.rule: forced: evenly spread over (paraphrase, sample) among program-set members with a unique uid; natural: per-label counts stratified to the full condition, each pick on the least-used template (2 per template W1-W5), numpy seed 0

state_basis.note: teacher-forced residual stream of each scrubbed program under the name-free baseline prompt (states/t1/base, float16), projected on the PCA-50 basis fitted on all forced programs of the 7 analysis algorithms; Euclidean distances among programs are the ones the original k-NN geodesic code sees

catalogue_keep.rule: T1 kept if >= 70% of its 40 forced programs are labelled as requested (attempted, regardless of pass); T2 algorithms always run in LOS, FRLP flagged unavailable if < 10 programs are labelled

from collections import deque

def solve(grid, start, goal):
    rows = len(grid)
    cols = len(grid[0]) if rows > 0 else 0

    # Check if start or goal is out of bounds or a wall
    if not (0 <= start[0] < rows and 0 <= start[1] < cols) or not (0 <= goal[0] < rows and 0 <= goal[1] < cols):
        return []
    if grid[start[0]][start[1]] == '#' or grid[goal[0]][goal[1]] == '#':
        return []

    # If start is the same as goal
    if start == goal:
        return [start]

    # Directions: up, down, left, right
    directions = [(-1, 0), (1, 0), (0, -1), (0, 1)]

    # BFS setup
    queue = deque()
    queue.append((start[0], start[1], [start]))
    visited = set()
    visited.add((start[0], start[1]))

    while queue:
        r, c, path = queue.popleft()
        for dr, dc in directions:
            nr, nc = r + dr, c + dc
            if 0 <= nr < rows and 0 <= nc < cols and grid[nr][nc] == '.' and (nr, nc) not in visited:
                if (nr, nc) == goal:
                    return path + [(nr, nc)]
                visited.add((nr, nc))
                queue.append((nr, nc, path + [(nr, nc)]))

    # No path found
    return []
